stems: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: Zero conditional: fakty i ogólne reguły – present simple w obu częściach.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Zero – Facts that are always true … If you heat ice, it melts.

stems: If it ___ tomorrow, I'll take the car.
questions.explanation: First conditional: realna sytuacja w przyszłości – if + present simple, main clause: will. Nie stawiamy will w zdaniu z if.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): First – If it rains, I'll take the car. ❌ If I will see him… → ✅ If I see him…

stems: If I ___ more time, I would learn Japanese.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: nierealna/mało prawdopodobna sytuacja teraz – if + past simple, would + verb.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Second – If I had more time, I would learn Japanese.

stems: If I had left earlier, I ___ the train.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: nierealna przeszłość – if + past perfect, would have + past participle.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Third – If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.

stems: If I ___ known about the party, I would have come.
questions.explanation: W zdaniu z if w 3. trybie – past perfect (had known), nie would have.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): ❌ If I would have known… → ✅ If I had known…

stems: If I ___ you, I would talk to her.
questions.explanation: If I were you – were dla wszystkich osób (standard); was tylko potocznie.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): „Were” for every person in the second conditional: If I were you…

stems: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
questions.explanation: Mixed: warunek z przeszłości → skutek teraz: if + past perfect, would + verb.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past condition → present result: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.

stems: If I were more organised, I ___ the deadline last week.
questions.explanation: Mixed: cecha teraz → skutek w przeszłości: if + past simple, would have + past participle.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Present condition → past result: If I were more organised, I wouldn't have missed the deadline.

stems: I won't go ___ you come with me. (= if you don't come)
questions.explanation: Unless = if … not.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Unless means if… not: I won't go unless you come.

stems: Take an umbrella ___ it rains. (as a precaution)
questions.explanation: In case = na wypadek gdyby (środek ostrożności), nie „jeśli”.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): in case means „as a precaution”, not „if”: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

stems: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully. (on condition that)
questions.explanation: As long as / provided that = pod warunkiem, że.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Other linking words: as long as, provided that, in case.

stems: I wish I ___ a bigger flat. (I live in a small one now)
questions.explanation: Wish – żal dotyczący teraźniejszości: past simple.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Present regret: I wish I had a bigger flat.

stems: I wish I ___ to the party last night. (I didn't go)
questions.explanation: Wish – żal dotyczący przeszłości: past perfect.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Past regret: I wish I had gone to the party.

stems: I wish you ___ interrupting me! (it annoys me)
questions.explanation: Wish + would – irytacja cudzym zachowaniem.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Annoyance about someone's behaviour: I wish you would stop interrupting.

stems: If you finish early, you ___ go home. (permission)
questions.explanation: Zamiast will/would można użyć modali: can, might, could.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Modals in place of will/would: If you finish early, you can go.

stems: Which sentence is correct?
correct: If I see him, I'll tell him.
distractors: If I will see him, I'll tell him.
If I would see him, I'll tell him.
If I'll see him, I tell him.
If I saw him, I'll tell him.
If I will see him, I tell him.
If I would see him, I would told him.
questions.explanation: Nie stawiamy will w zdaniu z if (1. tryb).
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): ❌ If I will see him, I'll tell him. → ✅ If I see him…

stems: Which sentence is correct?
correct: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
distractors: If I would be rich, I would travel the world.
If I will be rich, I would travel the world.
If I am rich, I would travel the world.
If I had been rich, I would travel the world last year.
If I were rich, I will travel the world.
If I would be rich, I travel the world.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: if + past simple (were), nie would be.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): ❌ If I would be rich… → ✅ If I were rich…

stems: A comma is needed in a conditional sentence:
correct: only when the if-clause comes first
distractors: only when the main clause comes first
questions.explanation: Przecinek po zdaniu z if tylko wtedy, gdy stoi ono na początku.
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Put a comma after the if-clause only when it comes first.

stems: „If I had a car…” refers to:
correct: the present – but the situation is imaginary
distractors: a general fact that is always true
questions.explanation: Czasy przeszłe w trybach warunkowych oznaczają nierealność, nie przeszłość: If I had = teraz (nierealnie); If I had had = przeszłość (nierealnie).
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): If I had a car… is about the present, but it's imaginary. If I had had a car… is about the past, and also imaginary.

stems: Which conditional describes something that did NOT happen in the past?
questions.explanation: Third – nierealna przeszłość (nie wydarzyło się).
questions.sourceExcerpt: Rozmowa o gramatyce (wklejona): Third – An unreal past (it didn't happen).
